item.prosthetic_arm_scrapdsc: An arm prosthetic made with scrap and wires. Maybe flesh isn't good enough for this place.
item.prosthetic_leg_scrapdsc: A leg prosthetic made with scrap and wires. Looks good enough to replace a missing leg.
item.prosthetic_arm_wooddsc: Cheap wooden arm. Brittle  - splinters into your stump when it breaks.
item.prosthetic_leg_wooddsc: Cheap wooden leg. Walking and jumping are slower. But you do feel like a pirate.
item.prosthetic_arm_titaniumdsc: Titanium arm. It doesn't feel like just a prosthetic; it feels like an improvement.
item.prosthetic_leg_titaniumdsc: Titanium leg. It doesn't feel like just a prosthetic; it feels like an improvement.
item.prosthetic_eyedsc:
A battery-powered eye. Restores sight in one socket while it has charge. Press F to activate light mode.

In wound view: any tool (knife, screwdriver, etc) ejects the battery. A fork ejects the battery first, then pulls the eye once the socket is empty; a wrench pulls the whole eye out, battery and all.
item.neuromod_painblockdsc:
Suppresses nerve pain signals  - all incoming pain is halved while installed.

<color="red">Ejecting this neuromod is dangerous. Expect brain flash and vomiting.
item.neuromod_trapdetectdsc:
Highlights all nearby traps with a red glow. Beartraps, landmines, coils and more.

<color="red">Ejecting this neuromod is dangerous. Expect brain flash and vomiting.
item.neuromod_sonicscreamerdsc:
Emits a high-frequency sonic burst  - sends all nearby creatures fleeing in a 25 unit radius for 2 seconds.

<color="red">3 uses. Safe to eject  - item is returned.
item.neuromod_crackedpainmoddsc:
A damaged pain neuromod, clearly ripped from someone else. Pain hurts 10% more with it in, but you start enjoying it  - mood rises passively the more you hurt.

<color="red">Removing this neuromod deals 5 brain damage, a brain flash, and 15 head pain.
item.neuromod_adrenalinesurgedsc:
When ragdolled and still conscious, you can activate it and stand up no matter what (even in air). Hurts like hell.

<color="red">Infinite uses, 1-minute cooldown. Safe to eject  - item is returned.
item.neuromod_lockindsc:
Shocks and force-starts specific neurons in the brain  - forces you awake for a minute no matter the state. The only neuromod usable while unconscious.

<color="red">Costs 10 brain integrity and 15 head muscle per use  - can be lethal at low brain. 10-minute cooldown. Safe to eject  - item is returned.
item.neuromod_sandivistiandsc:
<color="red">3 uses only.</color> Military-grade reflex booster. Slows perceived time. After 10s of use, causes severe sickness.

<color="red">Cannot eject while active. On last use, auto-breaks after 10s.
item.neuromod_scanningchipdsc:
Hold an item and activate to scan it for 3 seconds. Reveals the recipe and marks the item type as recognized for good.

<color="green">Safe to eject  - no side effects.
item.augment_steadyhanddsc: Wrist-mounted gyroscope. While powered, gun recoil drops by half and a live ammo count shows next to the held-item HUD. Small or medium battery.
item.augment_powergripdsc: Servo grip in the palm. While powered, held items weigh half, you hit harder and throw farther — and you won't drop what you're holding even if you pass out. Small or medium battery.
item.augment_hackingdsc: Intrusion suite wired into the hand. Skips lock minigames, keypads, and blood terminals — at a charge cost per hack. Always-on while powered. Small battery can't crack a blood terminal; medium can.
item.augment_implant_tooldsc:
Cuts a single augment socket into a biological arm, leg, or torso — run augments without going full prosthetic. Use in the wound view on a Shoulder, Thigh, or Torso.

<color="red">Single use. Slot is gone the moment the limb is severed.
item.augment_powerstepsdsc: Servo pistons in the thigh. While powered and active, leg speed and jump height climb +12.5% per leg — +25% with both. Small, medium, or large battery. One hotbar key fires both legs.
item.augment_treadmilldsc: Kinetic leg treadmill. Slot any battery (even empty), activate it, and moving or jumping slowly recharges it — big batteries fill slower. While active it drags leg speed & jump down 25% per leg (−50% with both). Auto-switches off when full. Can't activate a full or empty slot. One hotbar key fires both legs.
item.augment_rtgdsc:
A radioisotope thermoelectric generator bolted into the chest. Toggle it on to trickle-charge every augment battery and energy cell on your body at once. It bleeds radiation while it runs, glows blue, and shuts itself off the moment everything is topped up. Installs into an open torso augment slot.

<color="red">Permanent — once implanted it cannot be removed. It only comes out if the torso is severed.</color>
item.augment_ballisticdsc: you've never seen this before, looks like a very advanced augment, a white sticker on it says: experimental - protects from impact to the body, don't try it without me Permanent — once implanted it cannot be removed. It only comes out if the torso is severed.
item.augment_regendsc: you've never seen this before, looks like a very advanced augment, a grubby white sticker peeling off it reads: experimental - keeps the body stitching itself back together, the greying is normal, mind that it feeds on you, don't try it without me Permanent — once implanted it cannot be removed. It only comes out if the torso is severed.
item.bonesawdsc:
A proper surgical bone saw. The right tool for a clean cut.

<color="red">Can be used in the health panel to amputate any limb, even without infection or damage.
item.makeshiftbonesawdsc:
A crude improvised bone saw. Gets the job done, barely.

<color="red">Can be used in the health panel to amputate any limb, even without infection or damage.
item.plasticforkdsc:
I mean, it would be funny to poke an eye out from your friend or yourself to make space for the cool prosthetic eye, right? One use.

<color="red">Drag onto your head in the health panel to remove a biological eye.
<color="green">Also pries out an installed prosthetic eye without breaking it.
item.rippeddressingdsc: A strip of clean bandage cloth. Absorbs 25 wetness per use when used from inventory. 10 uses. Also works as a proper dressing on wounds.

building.neuromod_boxdsc: A sealed augmentation-corp crate. Reinforced metal plating, primitive keypad lock. Holds a single neuromod  - if you can crack it open.
building.augment_boxdsc: A sealed augmentation-corp crate. Reinforced metal plating, primitive keypad lock. Holds a single augment  - if you can crack it open.

other.weldingMinigameGuide: Press anywhere on the line and drag along it, either way around  - stray off and you burn extra charge.
other.runsetdisablebrainmodsdsc: No neuromods or neuromod crates spawn this run, and traders won't stock neuromods.
other.runsetwoodenstartdsc: Start with wooden prosthetics on all four limbs, a cyber eye (you need to find a battery tho), and a flimsy knife. Your int is 13 instead of 7 in singleplayer.
